quantifiers.original: For every admissible d,n,kappa and for each fixed b in {-1,+1}, draw the k O_j independently with the same mu_(n,b), then take the pushforward matrix law and average its Gaussian target. Equality is equality of probability measures, hence holds on every Borel event. There is no existential replacement family, no selected favorable prior, no almost-everywhere replacement of the law, and no universal mixed-sign pattern in Eq6.

scopes.original: The common sign is fixed before the independent block draws. Independence is conditional on/fiberwise in that sign; averaging over an additional common random sign generally destroys unconditional block independence and gives a mixture of products. Gaussian target averaging occurs after matrix-prior formation. The optional residual Gaussian is independent and identical under both signs. A standard canonical identification or proved transport between block and flat coordinates is legitimate; arbitrary reinterpretation of the target is not. p_b and bar_p_b downstream denote actual densities of P_b and bar_pi_b.
scopes.reconstructed: All block laws use one fixed sign b. The product prior yields conditional/fiberwise independence in that sign, with a common independent residual. The total Gaussian constructor/inverse is only interpreted as the source Gaussian on proved positive-definite source support. The zero-dimensional Gaussian is the probability unit, equivalent to omission; no isometry assertion is made for the ordinary product norm.
